description:
Level up your mental wellness. Happy turns Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) into an engaging, gamified journey designed to help you conquer anxiety, overcome overthinking, and build lasting emotional strength.

Think of Happy as Duolingo for mental health. Instead of dry clinical worksheets, you progress through interactive chapter maps, 5-minute microlearning courses, and cheerful celebration milestones with your panda companion.

WHY GAMIFIED CBT WORKS
Sticking to therapy and daily habits is hard. Happy makes learning therapeutic skills playful, visual, and rewarding with bite-sized lessons, XP rewards, milestone chests, and streak momentum.

KEY FEATURES

• Gamified CBT Journey Courses
Explore structured roadmaps that take you from emotional overwhelm to mental clarity. Complete 5-minute interactive lessons on challenging negative thinking traps, conquering catastrophizing, and calming panic loops.

• Interactive Chapter Maps & Quests
Level up as you master evidence-based CBT exercises. Unlock new chapters, collect XP chests, and celebrate your emotional milestones with cheerful mascot celebrations.

• Multimodal Voice & Photo Journaling
Speak your mind freely. Happy’s AI turns your voice notes into structured cognitive reflections. Snap a photo of your handwritten notebook pages to digitize them into searchable reflections.

• Multi-Timeframe Life Insights
Track your transformation over time. View daily timeline breakdowns, weekly mood curves, monthly emotional patterns, and yearly wellness rewinds to uncover what truly triggers your stress.

• 40+ Instant Coping Exercises
Access immediate relief when anxiety strikes with interactive grounding tools, Box Breathing (4-4-4-4), PMR muscle relaxation, and Thought Reframing cards.

• Streak Motivation & Panda Rewards
Keep your wellness habit alive. Earn daily streak flames and unlock fun rewards and customization items in the Shop.

• 100% Private & Protected
Your mental wellness journey is strictly yours. Your reflections and notes are protected with on-device security and private storage.

HOW YOUR JOURNEY BEGINS
1. Start Your Course: Choose your journey—from calming anxiety to quieting overthinking.
2. Complete 5-Minute Lessons: Learn practical CBT skills through interactive exercises.
3. Level Up & Reflect: Build streak momentum, collect rewards, and see real emotional progress.

Start your gamified mental health journey today with Happy.
